evidence.finding: Tanzil Quran Text is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Verbatim copying/distribution is permitted; changing the Quran text is not allowed; source attribution and linking back to Tanzil are required.
The official download page identifies the latest Quran text release as version 1.1, published in February 2021, and repeats the verbatim-use and attribution requirements.
Tanzil describes its Uthmani text as a Unicode encoding of the Medina Mushaf.
Tanzil documents text changes for version 1.1 and provides a maintained update history.
The legacy ingestion notebook explicitly records Tanzil as the Quran/translation source and identifies the local Arabic file as quran_arabic_uthmani.txt.

limitations: The legacy notebook directed the user to the Tanzil download page for the Arabic file rather than programmatically preserving a remote file checksum.
Therefore the exact remote artifact fingerprint that produced the local raw file cannot yet be independently reconstructed from Git history alone.
NB02/NB03 must bind the local raw SHA-256, header metadata, 6236-verse structure and canonical verse numbering before activation.
